pages.text: Smithed from an Unawakened Vessel combined with a Blood Feather, the Crescent Disaster is a $(l:weapons/weapon_types)$(c)$(o)Heavy Axe$() that deals a bit less damage, but can be thrown. It will return if enchanted with Loyalty. Throwing the axe can also be an effective way to create a small time window for switching to another weapon.
